svg.title: Korg ARP 2600 M connections
svg.desc: Connection inventory. Arrows indicate signal direction relative to the instrument. Locations identify hardware faces; the diagram is not a socket placement drawing. Physical control sections are listed below.
svg.metadata: Symbol vocabulary: NYU ABILITY Project / IDM SynthAccess; https://github.com/IDMNYU/synthaccess/tree/ee1ef12cec3a3fb6be59a7861f7df8848be2dafe/tactileSynthGuides. Original schematic geometry; physical controls do not imply MIDI mappings.

svg.text: PHYSICAL CONTROLS / see interface.svg for labelled positions

Preamp / Envelope follower / Ring modulator: Preamp input, Gain, Range x10 / x100 / x1000, Preamp output, Envelope follower input, Envelope follower level, Envelope follower output, Ring input 1, Ring
input 2, Ring input level 1, Ring input level 2, Audio / DC, Ring output
VCO 1: Frequency, Fine Tune, Audio / LF, KBD CV, S/H CV, ADSR CV, VCO 2 sine CV, CV level 2, CV level 3, CV level 4, Sawtooth out, Square out
VCO 2: Frequency, Fine Tune, Pulse Width, Audio / LF, KBD CV, S/H CV, ADSR CV, VCO 1 CV, CV level 2, CV level 3, CV level 4, Sawtooth out, PWM CV, PWM depth, Triangle out, Sine out, Pulse out
VCO 3: Frequency, Fine Tune, Pulse Width, Audio / LF, KBD CV, Noise CV, ADSR CV, VCO 2 sine CV, CV level 2, CV level 3, CV level 4, Sawtooth out, Pulse out

VCF: Frequency, Fine Tune, Resonance, Type I / II, Audio input 1, Audio input 2, Audio input 3, Audio input 4, Audio input 5, Audio level 1, Audio level 2, Audio level 3, Audio level 4, Audio level 5,
CV input 1, CV input 2, CV input 3, CV level 2, CV level 3, VCF out
ADSR / AR: Attack, Decay, Sustain, Release, ADSR out, AR attack, AR release, AR out, KBD / S-H gate, Gate input, Gate out, Trig out, Manual start
VCA: Initial gain, VCF audio in, Ring mod audio in, AR CV in, ADSR CV in, Audio level 1, Audio level 2, CV level 1, CV level 2, VCA out
Left speaker / Multiples: Left speaker, KBD CV-1, KBD CV-2, MOD CV, Multiple 1, Multiple 2, Multiple 3, Multiple 4
Noise generator: White / Pink / LF color, Noise level, Noise out
Voltage processors: Inverter input 1, Inverter input 2, Inverter input 3, Inverter input 4, Inverter input 5, Inverter input 6, Input level 2, Input level 4, Input level 6, Inverter out 1, Inverter
out 2, Lag input, Lag time, Lag output
Sample and hold / Electronic switch: Sample input, Int clock out, Sample out, Ext clock input, Level, Rate, Switch A, Switch B, Switch C
Mixer / Reverb: Input 1, Input 2, Level 1, Level 2, Audio out 1, Audio out 2, L-R input, Pan, Left input, Left output, Right input, Right output, Reverb input, Reverb level L, Reverb level R, Reverb
out
Right speaker / Power: Right speaker, Power, Stereo phones
Side panel: Mode switch 1-5
